definitions.gloss: cash on delivery; COD; payment on delivery
definitions.explanation: A payment method where the recipient pays the delivery person upon receiving the package, typically with cash or card.

examples.japanese: {代引|だいび}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: I ordered with cash on delivery.

examples.japanese: {代引|だいび}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: There is a fee for cash on delivery.

examples.japanese: ⟦クレジットカード→クレジットカード：06968_kurejittokaado⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{代引|だいび}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: Cash on delivery is convenient when you don't have a credit card.

notes:
Short for ⟦{代金引換|だいきんひきかえ}→代金引換：28163_daikinhikikae⟧ (exchange of goods for payment). The buyer pays the delivery person upon receiving the package.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {代引|だいび}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay by COD
- {代引|だいび}き{手数料|てすうりょう}: COD handling fee
- {代引|だいび}き⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧: COD available
- {代引|だいび}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}する→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧: to order with COD payment

USAGE:
{代引|だいび}き usually involves a ⟦{手数料|てすうりょう}→手数料：05423_tesuuryou⟧ (handling fee) of a few hundred yen, added on top of the purchase price.

OTHER PAYMENT METHODS:
- ⟦{着払|ちゃくばら}い→着払い：07950_chakubarai⟧: collect delivery (recipient pays shipping only — different from {代引|だいび}き)
- ⟦{前払|まえばら}い→前払い：15782_maebarai⟧: prepayment
- ⟦{後払|あとばら}い→後払い：17771_atobarai⟧: deferred/delayed payment
- ⟦クレジットカード→クレジットカード：06968_kurejittokaado⟧⟦{払|ばら}い→払い：09655_barai⟧: credit card payment
